Laura —

Quick review: W-9 looks complete but the EIN on the W-9 (26-3141592) matches, however the bank authorization form lists the account holder as "Prime Procure LLC" (note the space). That's a minor naming mismatch that can cause bank validation failures on ACH. Can we ask Emily to confirm the exact legal name on file with the bank and, if possible, provide the Certificate of Incorporation or a bank statement showing the account name?

For ACH validation: the BankAuth + micro-deposit is our standard — we need either the signed BankAuth (we have it) plus a successful micro-deposit verification from the bank. If they prefer wire for the first payment, AP can do a one-time wire after we create the vendor record.

If Emily can upload the Certificate of Incorporation, I'll complete the vendor due-diligence check and sign off.
